Section 7.2 to increase the easterly side yard lot line setback and the rear yard setback from 12 metres to 32 metre subject to the following conditions:
A development agreement is registered on title that requires the dwelling be located no closer than 32 metres to the easterly side lot line and no closer than 32 metres to the rear lot line;
The development agreement will also include a clause advising future purchasers that the lot is located within the agricultural area and may therefore be subjected to noise, dust, odours and other nuisances associated with traditional agricultural uses of land and normal farm practices. This notice would also include the Owner’s acknowledgment that farming operations may expand in the future.
A provision that central air conditioning should be installed also be included within the agreement.

THAT the Committee of Adjustment grant relief for the property located at 402 Butler Farm Road, Plan 15M32, Lot 1, former Township of Oxford-on-Rideau, now the Municipality of North Grenville from the following sections of Comprehensive Zoning By-law 50-12:
6.12 L) to permit a height of approximately 6.10 metres whereas the maximum is 6 metres; and
6.12 k) i. to permit an additional residential unit within a proposed detached garage to be located closer to a street than the principal dwelling.
The following condition applies to the variance:
That the applicant provide an updated lot grading and drainage plan to the satisfaction of the Public Works Department.
The requested relief is recommended because the request is minor, the intent of the Comprehensive Zoning By-law and Official Plan are being maintained, and the variance is within the parameters for accessory structures and dwellings in the Residential designation.
